sys_hub_action_type_definition.description:
Use this action when the student asks to summarize, review, explain, or provide an overview of their visa case or visa cases.
Use this action for requests such as:
- Summarize my case - Summarize my visa case - Summarize my visa cases - Summarize all my visa cases - Can you summarize my case? - Can you summarize my visa case? - Can you summarize my visa cases? - Give me a case summary - Give me a visa case summary - Give me a summary of my case - Give me a summary of my visa cases - Case summary - What is the summary of my case? - What is the summary of my visa cases? - Give me an overview of my visa cases - Review my visa case - Review my visa cases - Explain my visa case - Explain my visa cases
If the student provides a specific case number, summarize only that case.
If the student asks for a general summary of their visa cases without specifying a case number, use the student's available visa case context and summarize the cases provided.
Do not use Get Current Student Visa Case Context for summary requests.
The words "summarize", "summary", "overview", "review", or "case summary" indicate that this action should be used.
